# Captured analysis output

Raw `cargo aquascope permissions` stdout for fixtures in `../workspace/`, so that parsing and selection are tested without the toolchain. `05_method_mut_borrow`, `n1_non_ascii`, `e3_mod_other` and `e4_mixed_errors` are copied from spike 003's `work/results/noflag/`; `n2_nested` was captured the same way on 2026-11-06 (Aquascope v0.4.0, `nightly-2026-05-01`, edition 2024, library crate, no `--should-fail`). The `*.check.jsonl` files are the `cargo check --message-format=json` stdout for the same crates, copied from spike 003's `work/results/diagnostics/`, and feed the R10 classification tests. `n3_early_return` was captured the same way on 2026-11-08 with the pinned fork (`v0.4.0-vscode.1`, ADR 0004); for every other fixture the fork's output has the same content as v0.4.0's, so those captures still hold. Recapture them all if the pinned Aquascope version changes.

The `*.interp.json` files are raw `cargo aquascope interpreter` stdout for feature 007, captured on 2026-11-08 by `spikes/007-interpreter/probe.sh` (Aquascope v0.4.0, `nightly-2026-05-01`, edition 2024, binary crate, with a Miri-built standard library): `01_move_string`, `05_method_mut_borrow` and `n1_non_ascii` hold traces, `i4_use_after_free` a trace ending in undefined behaviour, and `i1_panic` the bare build error a runtime panic returns. `i6_no_main.check.jsonl` is the `cargo check` stdout for the program without `main` (E0601). Recapture them with that script if the pinned Aquascope version changes.
